record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、LLM inference efficiencyとの接続、効果の一般性または技術的な新規性が弱く、理由を付してborderlineに残す。OSWorld-Human measures end-to-end computer-use agent efficiency, identifies large model calls and long step sequences as major latency sources, and reports current agents use 2.7–4.3x more steps than humans. It is a benchmark/diagnostic study, not an inference
record.title: OSWorld-Human: Benchmarking the Efficiency of Computer-Use Agents
